_comment: Cobble Bosses. allowBossCapture=false disables capturing every boss. structures.generate=false turns natural generation off (/place still works). rewards.lootRadius = maximum distance from the boss to receive rewards; rewards.lootShareByDamage splits the loot by who dealt the most damage instead of giving everything to one player.
_bossAttack_help: bossDamageMultiplier = damage the boss TAKES. bossAttackDamageMultiplier = damage boss attacks deal to players. armorPiercing (0-1) = share of armor reduction the boss ignores (0 = vanilla armor, 0.5 = full netherite blocks half of what it normally would).

rewards._commands_help: Server commands run once per rewarded player for every boss, on top of items, XP and the arena chest. Text, or {"command": "...", "chance": 1.0, "challenger_only": false}. Placeholders: {player} {uuid} {boss} {species} {x} {y} {z} {dimension}, and {amount} (requires total). Optional total: non-negative integer (long). Without split_by_damage, each player receives total. Example object: {"command": "cobbledollars give {player} {amount}", "total": 100000, "split_by_damage": true, "min_share_floor": 0.2}. Damage means shield damage, not turn-based battle damage. Split among connected rewarded players within lootRadius; floor each amount, remainder to highest damage (first in ascending UUID order on ties). min_share_floor defaults to 0 and is clamped to [0,1]. With split_by_damage and a positive floor, each weight is max(damage share, min_share_floor), then normalized by the sum of weights. This overrides min_damage_share and also pays players with no damage, including companions. It is a weight floor, not a guaranteed percentage of total: 95/5 damage with floor 0.2 pays 82609/17391 of 100000. With no damage, a positive floor splits equally; floor 0 gives main total. Without a floor, winning with little shield damage earns little and no damage earns 0 from split commands (items/XP unchanged). min_share_floor is ignored without split_by_damage. Amounts of 0 are skipped. min_damage_share defaults to 0, applies only to split commands, and never excludes a sole rewarded player. Minimum/challenger_only/chance filter after splitting without redistributing skipped shares: challenger_only earns only the main player's proportion. Example: "cobbledollars give {player} 25000". A boss JSON can add its own rewards.commands and set rewards.skip_global_commands=true to skip these.
rewards._randomCommandRewards_help: Weighted random extra reward, rolled independently for each rewarded player on top of the guaranteed commands. rolls = how many times each player rolls (1-10); weight = relative chance (0 or less removes the entry); challenger_only = only the player who won the battle can get it. A boss JSON can add rewards.random_command_rewards with the same format. Same placeholders as commands.

spawner._respawn_help: Each boss block has its own respawn time (arenas ship with 72000 ticks = 1 hour of play; change one block with its config screen or /cobblebosses spawner respawn). respawnTicksOverride: -1 = use each block's time; 0 or more = force that time on ALL blocks (20 ticks = 1 s, 0 = never respawns).
